blurb: Guests can choose from various boat charters including sightseeing tours of Jacksonville waterways, day trips with stops at local hidden spots, and burial at sea services. The vessel is a 26-foot Monterey Explorer Bowrider with a bimini top, seating for up to 5 guests, and limited restroom facilities. The captain and crew are certified in safety and life support, and charters include drinks and snacks or meals depending on the package.
